```{r}
# Read in all pit tag data (exp0, exp1, exp2 and exp3)
dir1<-"./data/extern/pit/"
folders<-list.files(path=dir1)
for (i in 1:length(folders)){
  dir2<-paste0(dir1,folders[i],"/")
  files<-list.files(path=dir2)
  for (j in 1:length(files)){
    dir3<-paste0(dir2,files[j])
    file<-read.table(dir3,header=FALSE,sep='\t')
    file<-as.data.frame(file[substr(file$V1, 0, 1) == "D", ])
    file<-as.data.frame(str_split_fixed(file[,1], "\\s+", 12))[,c(2,3,6)]
    colnames(file)<-c("Date","Time","tag_code")
    file$event_date_time_value<-round_date(as.POSIXct(paste(file$Date,file$Time),format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS",tz="Europe/Brussels"),unit="1 second")
    attr(file$event_date_time_value, "tzone") <- "UTC"
    file<-file %>% dplyr::select(-Date,-Time)
    file$event_site_code_value<-sub("\\s+[^ ]+$", "", files[j])
    if (i==1 & j==1){data=file} else{data=rbind(data,file)}
  }
}
remove(dir1,dir2,dir3,file,folders,files)
data$event_site_code_value=gsub(" ","_",tolower(data$event_site_code_value))
data$antenna_id="01"
data$antenna_group_configuration_value=100
data<-data[startsWith(data$tag_code,"9")==TRUE,]
data<-data[-which(data$tag_code %in% c("900_2280000_228000535717","900_2280\xc9D\xe2LI","900_228000535Y")),]
data$tag_code<-gsub("_","",data$tag_code)
data$event_site_code_value[which(data$event_site_code_value=="vdz_boven")]="antenna_up"
data$event_site_code_value[which(data$event_site_code_value=="vdz_onder")]="antenna_down"

data$exp<-NA
data$exp[which(format(as.Date(data$event_date_time_value, format="%d/%m/%Y"),"%Y")=="2023")]="exp0"
data$exp[which(data$event_date_time_value>=start.exp1 & data$event_date_time_value<=stop.exp1)]="exp1"
data$exp[which(data$event_date_time_value>=start.exp2 & data$event_date_time_value<=stop.exp2)]="exp2"
data$exp[which(data$event_date_time_value>=start.exp3 & data$event_date_time_value<=stop.exp3)]="exp3"
data$tag_code<-paste0(data$tag_code,"_",data$exp)
data$type<-"detection"

remove(i,j)
```

```{r}
# Read in valve data of exp1, exp2 and exp3 (different format from exp0 :( )
dir1<-"./data/extern/valves/2024/"
files<-list.files(path=dir1)
for (i in 1:length(files)){
  dir2<-paste0(dir1,files[i])
  file<-read.csv(dir2,sep=";")
  temp_onder_2024<-file[,c(1,2)]
  temp_boven_2024<-file[,c(3,4)]
  if (i==1){
    gate_onder_2024=temp_onder_2024
    gate_boven_2024=temp_boven_2024
  } else{
    gate_onder_2024=rbind(gate_onder_2024,temp_onder_2024)
    gate_boven_2024=rbind(gate_boven_2024,temp_boven_2024)
    }
}

gate_onder_2024<-gate_cleaning(gate_onder_2024,"2024")
gate_onder_2024$node<-"antenna_down"
gate_boven_2024<-gate_cleaning(gate_boven_2024,"2024")
gate_boven_2024$node<-"antenna_up"

gate<-rbind(gate,gate_onder_2024,gate_boven_2024)
remove(gate_onder_2024,gate_boven_2024,dir1,dir2,files,file,i)
```

```{r}
start.gate<-c(start.gate0,start.gate1,start.gate2,start.gate3)
stop.gate<-c(stop.gate0,stop.gate1,stop.gate2,stop.gate3)
interval.gate<-data.frame(start.gate, stop.gate)

gate<-interval.gate %>%
  mutate(date_time = purrr::map2(start.gate, stop.gate, seq, "sec")) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(date_time) %>%
  dplyr::select(-start.gate, -stop.gate) %>%
  left_join(gate, by = 'date_time') 

gate <- gate %>%
  mutate(exp.gate = case_when(date_time>=start.gate0 & date_time<=stop.gate0 ~ "exp0",
                              date_time>=start.gate1 & date_time<=stop.gate1 ~ "exp1", 
                              date_time>=start.gate2 & date_time<=stop.gate2 ~ "exp2",
                              date_time>=start.gate3 & date_time<=stop.gate3 ~ "exp3")) %>%
  arrange(node,exp.gate,date_time) %>%
  group_by(node,exp.gate) %>%
  mutate(der=opening-dplyr::lag(opening,10))

#            )
```

```{r}
# Read in length and species data of exp0, exp1, exp2 and exp3
dir1<-"./data/extern/lengte_en_soort/verwerkt/"
folders<-list.files(path=dir1)
for (i in 1:length(folders)){
  dir2<-paste0(dir1,folders[i])
  temp<-read_excel(path=dir2)
  tag_code_start<-parse_number(colnames(temp)[4])
  colnames(temp)<-c("soort","lengte","gewicht","tag_code","opmerkingen")
  temp$tag_code<-paste0(tag_code_start,as.character(temp$tag_code))
  if (i==1){metadata=temp} else{metadata=rbind(metadata,temp)}
}
metadata$opmerkingen<-NULL
metadata[which(metadata$tag_code %in% metadata$tag_code[which(duplicated(metadata$tag_code)==TRUE)]),c("lengte","gewicht")]=NA
metadata<-metadata[!duplicated(metadata), ]
remove(temp,temp_boven_2024,temp_onder_2024,folders,tag_code_start)
```

```{r}
# summarize pit tag data
comp_obs <- compress(cth_file = data)
comp_obs<-comp_obs %>% 
            group_by(tag_code) %>%
            mutate(last_sequence=paste0(dplyr::lag(node),"-",node),
                   exp=gsub(".*_", "", tag_code),
                   tag_code2=gsub("\\_.*","", tag_code)) %>%
            ungroup()

hergebruikt<-comp_obs %>%
            dplyr::select(tag_code2,exp,tag_code) %>%
            distinct() %>%
            group_by(tag_code2) %>%
            arrange((exp)) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(hergebruikt = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            dplyr::select(tag_code,hergebruikt) 

comp_dir <- addDirection(compress_obs = comp_obs,
                         parent_child = parent_child_nodes,
                         direction = "u")

comp_dir<-left_join(comp_dir,gate %>% dplyr::select(-measurement),by=join_by(min_det==date_time,node==node))
comp_dir<-left_join(comp_dir,metadata,by=join_by(tag_code2==tag_code))
comp_dir<-left_join(comp_dir,hergebruikt,by=join_by(tag_code==tag_code))
remove(comp_obs, hergebruikt)
```

```{r}
links <- comp_dir %>%

            dplyr::select(tag_code,start,stop,exp) %>%

            ungroup() %>%
            group_by(exp,start,stop) %>%
            summarize(n=n_distinct(tag_code)) %>%
            mutate(color = case_when(start == "basin down" & stop == "antenna_down" ~ "green",
                                     start == "antenna_down" & stop == "antenna_up" ~ "green",
                                     start == "antenna_up" & stop == "basin up" ~ "green",
                                     .default = "red")) %>%
            ungroup()

nodes <- comp_dir %>% 
            dplyr::select(node,exp,tag_code) %>%
            group_by(exp,node) %>%
            summarize(n=n_distinct(tag_code)) %>%
```

## Passage success

```{r}
passage_succes<-function(pattern_value,berekening_value){
  data<-comp_dir %>% 
      mutate(niveau = case_when(sapply(node, grepl, pattern = pattern_value) ~ "boven",
                            .default = "beneden"),
             calculation=berekening_value) %>%
      group_by(exp, niveau, calculation) %>%
      summarise(unieke_tags = n_distinct(tag_code)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      group_by(exp, calculation) %>%
      summarise(passage_succes=round(unieke_tags[niveau=="boven"]/unieke_tags[niveau=="beneden"],digits=2)) 
  return(data)
}

rbind(passage_succes(pattern_value='up',berekening_value="recapture and detections"),
      passage_succes(pattern_value='basin up',berekening_value="recapture"),
      passage_succes(pattern_value='antenna_up',berekening_value="detections")) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = exp, values_from = passage_succes) %>%
  kable(caption="Passage success calculated in different ways.")
```

```{r}
  summarise(eerste_detectie=min(min_det)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  dplyr::select(tag_code,antenna_down,antenna_up,`basin up`) %>%
```

## Travel time

```{r}
tags_boven=unique(comp_dir$tag_code[which(comp_dir$node=="antenna_up" & dplyr::lag(comp_dir$node)=="antenna_down")])

comp_dir %>% 
  dplyr::filter(tag_code %in% tags_boven & node=="antenna_up") %>% 
  mutate(travel_time=round(travel_time),
         since_open=round(since_open),
         opening=round(opening,digits=2)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(tag_code,travel_time,min_det,max_det,since_open,opening) %>% 
  arrange(min_det,tag_code) %>%
  group_by(tag_code) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  kable(caption="Travel time (min) to move up the fish spiral calculated as the time difference between the last detection at the lower antenna and the first at the upper antenna. The time since the upper valve opened and the first detection at the upper antenna are given. The opening (cm) at which the firt detection at the upper antenna is noted is also given. Some fish went up and down several times. Subsequent trajectories are numbered under loop.",longtable=TRUE) %>% 
  kable_styling(latex_options="scale_down") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%", box_css = "border: 0px;")
```

```{r fig.cap = "Travel time from the lower to the upper antenna for fish used 1, 2 and 3 times for the experiments."}
tags_boven=unique(comp_dir$tag_code[which(comp_dir$node=="antenna_up" & dplyr::lag(comp_dir$node)=="antenna_down")])

b<-ggplot(data=comp_dir %>%
            dplyr::filter(tag_code %in% tags_boven & node=="antenna_up") %>% 
            dplyr::filter(is.na(travel_time)==FALSE) %>%
            dplyr::filter(!(abs(travel_time - median(travel_time)) > 1.5*sd(travel_time))) %>%
            arrange(tag_code,min_det) %>%
            group_by(tag_code) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
            dplyr::filter(loop == 1),
          aes(as.factor(hergebruikt), travel_time),size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_boxplot(linetype = 1, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  ylab("Travel time from the lower to the upper antenna (minutes)") + 
  xlab("Number of times used for the experiment") + 
  theme_bw()
print(b)
```

```{r fig.cap = "Travel time from lower to upper antenna for different loops during an experiment for fish used 1, 2 and 3 times for the experiments."}
give.n <- function(x){
  return(c(y = median(x)+100, label = length(x))) 
}

tags_boven=unique(comp_dir$tag_code[which(comp_dir$node=="antenna_up" & dplyr::lag(comp_dir$node)=="antenna_down")])

b<-ggplot(data=comp_dir %>%
            dplyr::filter(tag_code %in% tags_boven & node=="antenna_up") %>%

            dplyr::filter(!(abs(travel_time - median(travel_time)) > 1.5*sd(travel_time))) %>%
            arrange(tag_code,min_det) %>%
            group_by(tag_code) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(loop = dplyr::row_number()),
          aes(as.factor(loop), travel_time),size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_boxplot(linetype = 1, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
```

## Graphs valve opening exp0 (mei 2023)

```{r}
plot_vdz <- function(start, stop, node_input, exp_input, points = FALSE){
  start = as.POSIXct(start,tz = "UTC")
  stop = as.POSIXct(stop,tz = "UTC")
  
  g<-ggplot(gate %>% dplyr::filter(date_time>start & date_time<stop & node==node_input) ,aes(x=date_time,y=opening))+
    geom_line()
  if (points == TRUE){
    g<-g+geom_point(data=gate %>% dplyr::filter(date_time>start & date_time<stop & node==node_input & measurement == TRUE),aes(x=date_time,y=opening))
  }
  g<-g+geom_vline(data=comp_dir %>% dplyr::filter(exp==exp_input & node==node_input),aes(xintercept = min_det),colour="red",size=1,alpha=0.3)+
    ylab("opening valve (cm)")+
    xlab("date")
  print(g)
}
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.cap="Progression of the upper valve opening over time in blue. The vertical red lines represent the first detection at the upper valve per attempt per fish."}
plot_vdz(start=start.exp0,stop=stop.exp0,node_input="antenna_up",exp_input="exp0")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.cap="Progression of the lower valve opening over time in blue. The vertical red lines represent the first detection at the lower valve per attempt per fish."}
plot_vdz(start=start.exp0,stop=stop.exp0,node_input="antenna_down",exp_input="exp0")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.cap="Progression of the upper valve opening over time in blue. The vertical red lines represent the first detection at the upper valve per attempt per fish."}
plot_vdz(start=start.exp0,stop=stop.exp0,node_input="antenna_up",exp_input="exp0", points = TRUE)
```

## Network analysis

```{r}
plot_network<-function(exp_input,to_include="all"){
  if (to_include=="all"){
    d=links %>% 
       dplyr::filter(exp==exp_input) %>%
       dplyr::select(-exp)
    vertices=nodes %>% 
       dplyr::filter(exp==exp_input) %>%
       dplyr::select(-exp)
  } else{
    d=links %>% 
       dplyr::filter(exp==exp_input & stop!="inner ring" & stop!="outer ring") %>%
       dplyr::select(-exp)
    vertices=nodes %>% 
       dplyr::filter(exp==exp_input & node!="inner ring" & node!="outer ring") %>%
       dplyr::select(-exp)
  }
    
  network <- graph_from_data_frame(d,vertices,directed=T) 
  l <- layout_on_grid(network)
  plot(network, edge.width=E(network)$n/8, vertex.size=V(network)$n, layout = l, edge.curved=0.5, 
       edge.color=E(network)$color,edge.label = d$n,vertex.label = paste(vertices$node,vertices$n,sep="\n"),vertex.label.cex=2,edge.label.cex=2)
}
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.cap="Netwerkanalyse voor exp0."}
plot_network("exp0")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.cap="Netwerkanalyse voor exp1."}
plot_network("exp1", to_include = "not all")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.cap="Netwerkanalyse voor exp2."}
plot_network("exp2")
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=10, fig.cap="Netwerkanalyse voor exp3."}
plot_network("exp3", to_include = "not all")
```
